name: Tamagawa
tagline: Shibuya in 19 minutes and Shinagawa in 23 minutes. Served by 3 lines. A one-room flat rents for roughly ¥80,000 to ¥90,000.
summary: The station is in Ota City, served by Tokyu Toyoko Line, Tokyu Meguro Line and Tokyu Tamagawa Line. Journey times to the main business districts are 38 minutes to Otemachi, 29 minutes to Shinjuku, 19 minutes to Shibuya and 23 minutes to Shinagawa. A one-room flat rents for roughly ¥80,000 to ¥90,000. The station stands 11.3 m above sea level, and the ground within 800 m varies in height by 21.4 m. The land around the station rises and falls sharply.

terrain.note: The station sits lower than the ground around it, at 11.3 m above sea level. Within 800 m the ground ranges from 5.6 m to 27 m, a difference of 21.4 m. These figures were read from the elevation API of the Geospatial Information Authority of Japan at nine points: the station itself and eight compass directions 400 m out.

hazards: On the flood hazard map for the largest rainfall the government models, the station itself falls outside the projected inundation area. Of the nine points within 400 m of the station, 1 fall inside the area, and the deepest projection among them is less than 0.5 m. The projected depth differs block by block within the same station area, so check the ward hazard map for the specific address. Inland flooding from overwhelmed drains has no nationwide map; each ward publishes its own, and that is worth reading as well.

medical: Within an 800 m walk of the station there are 4 clinics and 1 pharmacy. Facilities recorded as hospitals lie at 田園調布中央病院, about 358 m away and ハンズ整骨院, about 1335 m away. OpenStreetMap does not record whether a facility admits inpatients or which departments it runs, so check each one on its own website. For which clinics open at night and at weekends, ask the emergency advice line of the ward you live in.
stationNote: 3 lines serve the station: Tokyu Toyoko Line, Tokyu Meguro Line and Tokyu Tamagawa Line. All 3 lines are run by Tokyu, so a fault affecting that company can stop them together. Scored out of 100 from the number of lines and the spread of operators, transfer convenience here comes to 68.

rentRange.note: One room ¥80,000 to ¥90,000, 1K ¥90,000 to ¥100,000, 1LDK ¥150,000 to ¥160,000 and 2LDK ¥230,000 to ¥240,000. These are the per-station averages published by LIFULL HOME'S, Yahoo! Real Estate and at home, averaged together and rounded down to the nearest ¥10,000 (our own survey). All three are asking rents, so what tenants finally agree can be lower. Within the same station area the figure moves a great deal with the age of the building, the walk from the station, and whether the flat faces a main road.

neighbours.lead: Den-En-Chofu is ahead on how little of the area is in the flood projection, but Tamagawa is ahead on the number of lines.
neighbours.note: 812 m away in a straight line. It reaches Otemachi in about the same time as Tamagawa.

leads.terrain: The ground around the station rises and falls sharply, and living above or below the slope changes how much effort getting about takes.
leads.groceries: There are 4 supermarkets within walking distance, and the nearest is 10 minutes on foot.
leads.hazards: Among the 23 wards' stations, very few of the points around this one fall inside the projected inundation area for the largest rainfall the government models.
leads.stationNote: Only the 多摩堤通り (1 lanes each way) runs 200 m away. Morning and evening, the cars are audible indoors serves this station, so when it stops you walk to another station.
leads.rentRange: Set against how long the commute takes, rents here are among the lowest in the 23 wards.
leads.medical: The number of clinics and pharmacies within walking distance is about average for the 23 wards.
